question: Should OpenClaw restore `PluginRuntime.channel.turn` as a deprecated compatibility alias, and should the alias be limited to the inbound-shaped helper set in this PR?
rationale: This changes the public plugin runtime contract and deprecation scope, which automation cannot safely decide even though the technical patch is narrow.

options.title: Accept Narrow Alias
options.body: Refresh the branch and land the object-identical `turn` alias with only the helper names currently documented as `inbound.*`.

options.title: Broaden Legacy Scope
options.body: Require the PR to restore the older helper names too, or explicitly document why those names are not part of the compatibility promise.

options.title: Reject Core Alias
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers decide old plugins must release against `channel.inbound.*` instead of restoring the legacy host surface.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Alias
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch and land the object-identical `turn` alias with only the helper names currently documented as `inbound.*`.

likelyOwner.reason: The removal commit is the clearest history signal for deciding whether to reinstate the legacy runtime alias.
